messages.subject: Regulator data return reminder
messages.bodyPreview: The annual data return opens on 9 November. Finance have the stock figures; I need the tenant satisfaction measures by the 20th.

messages.subject: Pension scheme valuation
messages.bodyPreview: The actuary's draft valuation is in. Contribution rates hold for next year; papers for the audit committee attached.

messages.subject: Office car park resurfacing
messages.bodyPreview: The contractor resurfaces the staff car park on Saturday 14 November. Please park on Mill Lane that day.

messages.subject: Wyndale Council partnership meeting
messages.bodyPreview: Notes from the council's housing partnership meeting: the warm homes grant round opens in January and we can bid for 60 homes.

messages.subject: Tenant panel chair stepping down
messages.bodyPreview: Mr Varley is stepping down as chair after six years. The panel will choose a new chair in December.

messages.subject: Insurance renewal quotes
messages.bodyPreview: Three quotes for the property insurance renewal are in the shared folder. Recommendation to follow at the audit committee.

messages.subject: Staff survey results
messages.bodyPreview: Response rate 78 per cent this year. Headline: people value flexible working; the depot wants a better canteen.

messages.subject: Annual report design
messages.bodyPreview: First design ideas for the annual report attached. We would like to use photos from the Fold Yard garden project.

messages.subject: Visit from the housing ombudsman team
messages.bodyPreview: The ombudsman's learning team would like to visit in January to talk about complaint handling. Proposed dates attached.

messages.subject: Christmas closure dates
messages.bodyPreview: The office closes at 1pm on 24 December and reopens on 4 January. The out-of-hours service runs as normal.

messages.subject: Audit committee agenda
messages.bodyPreview: Draft agenda for 26 November: insurance, pensions, internal audit of void works, the risk register.

messages.subject: Thank-you from Wyndale foodbank
messages.bodyPreview: Thank you to everyone at Thornbeck for the harvest collection: 214 kg of food and toiletries.
